image_safety: Output only the designed artwork. No metadata, annotations, file paths, or technical overlays.
non_interface_quality_prelude: Editorial photography, medium-format depth, real material textures — never CGI renders.
copy_anchor_with_strings: Approved copy only: {quoted_strings}. If none fit, render no text. Never invent slogans or captions.
copy_anchor_no_strings: Use only explicit user-provided copy. If none given, render no text. Never invent slogans or captions.
compact_bans_interface: Preserve the real product UI exactly. No invented chrome, no floating elements, no simplified redrawing.
compact_bans_non_interface: No metadata overlays, no technical annotations, no prompt text rendered as content.
brand_anchor_acceptable: exact mark geometry or approved motif
real product surface or workflow proof
brand name or approved product phrase

visual_angles: Wordmark + one strong product crop + one proof line
Logo-led ad illustration + short slogan + one small UI proof inset (roughly 20–25% visual weight max)
Quiet product frame + bold headline + minimal proof chips
anti_patterns: screenshot-only composition with no brand copy
headline text invented by the image model
social card without visible brand anchor
portrait card with a full screenshot competing against the headline

base: Brand direction: warm cream field, terracotta/rust accents, dark ink typography, premium editorial spacing, clear brand logo.
Critical rule: the proof must read as a real information module, not a vague decorative UI rectangle.
Do not clip the proof against the canvas edge. Keep every module fully inside the card bounds.
Do not use process labels like social square, brand-first share card, ~20% weight, or secondary cue as visible copy.
Use actual product language from the page: real titles, real metadata, real labels, real summaries. Avoid generic startup copy.
Prefer a recreated HTML/text proof module over a tiny raster screenshot. A small screenshot crop may appear only as subtle supporting texture.
No overlapping support renders on top of the proof. No fake UI chrome. No invented product claims.
Depict a single branded artifact frame, not a website, homepage, archive, magazine spread, or publication shell.
Do not generate navigation, tabs, mastheads, issue numbers, publication dates, search/menu controls, or decorative archive labels unless they exist in the source.
Do not hallucinate a QR code, barcode, extra logo, or substitute wordmark; reserve clean space for injected assets instead.
announcement_card: Use one strong title field and one subordinate reading card. This should feel like a branded artifact share, not a site landing page.
Avoid multi-section homepage layouts, mastheads, or navigation-heavy compositions.
The QR code is a support element only; it must not compete with the headline or proof.
governed_entity: For governed text artifacts, curate proof language for scanning: prefer coverage, capabilities, topics, or categories over procedural steps.
Do not surface instructional headings like How to Use, Step 1, Recommended search order, Example workflow, or install/setup text.
If the source text is mostly procedural, condense it into editorial labels and short semantic proof lines rather than repeating instructions verbatim.
Prompt and skill shares should look like a single source document or excerpt sheet, not a publication brand system with invented sections.

html_taste_directives.typography: Cormorant Garamond (serif) for headlines: weight 700, tracking -0.035em, line-height 0.94. Manrope (sans-serif, Geist fallback) for body: weight 500, line-height 1.55. Labels and kickers: Manrope 700-800, tracking 0.16-0.18em, uppercase. Never use pure black; all text uses warm ink #2a231a at varying opacities (headline 100%, body 68-76%, metadata 44-62%).
html_taste_directives.color: Warm cream field #f4ebd9. Single accent: rust #c67b5c. Ink: #2a231a. Sage: #9caf99 (backgrounds only, max 16% opacity). Sand: #eadbcc. All shadows brown-based rgba(42,35,26,n), never pure black. Accent borders use rust at 14-20% opacity. Max 1 saturated accent color per card.
html_taste_directives.surfaces: Proof cards: double-bezel with outer ring (1px rgba(42,35,26,.04) at inset -1px) and inner highlight (inset 0 1px 1px rgba(255,255,255,.22)). Three-layer shadow: ambient (0 20px 48px, 10% opacity), edge (0 2px 8px, 6% opacity), inset highlight. Detail tiles inside proof use softer shadow (inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.52)). SVG noise grain overlay at 2.8% opacity on cream background for tactile depth.
html_taste_directives.border_radius_hierarchy: Frame: 0 (canvas edge). Proof card: 22px. Proof ::before bezel: 23px. Detail tiles: 20px (concentric to proof). Proof crops: 18px. QR containers: 14-16px. Logo tile: 20-24px. Pills/badges/CTA: 999px.
html_taste_directives.shadow_system: Logo: 0 12px 28px rgba(42,35,26,.12). Proof card: 0 20px 48px rgba(42,35,26,.10), 0 2px 8px rgba(42,35,26,.06), inset 0 1px 1px rgba(255,255,255,.22). CTA button: 0 4px 14px rgba(198,123,92,.22) — rust-tinted. Detail tiles: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.52). All shadows warm-tinted; never rgba(0,0,0,n).
html_taste_directives.spacing: Card padding: 68-84px from frame edge. Grid gaps: 20-24px between major zones. Proof interior padding: 24-34px. Label-to-content margin: 12-18px. Proof-row separator: 1px solid rgba(42,35,26,.08) with 14px padding-top. All spacing in 4px increments.
html_taste_directives.type_scale: Display: 64-104px (headline, varies by card size). Title: 28-34px (proof-title). Lead: 24px (prompt-detail-lead). Body: 16-17px (excerpt, detail values). Small: 13-14px (domain, source-link, proof-row). Micro: 11-12px (labels, kickers, captions). Stat: 34px weight 800 tracking -0.04em (detail-block-value).
anti_patterns: Inter or Roboto as sole typeface
purple or blue AI gradient aesthetic
neon outer glow or saturated drop shadows
pure black (#000000) text, backgrounds, or shadows
AI copywriting cliches (elevate, seamless, unleash, next-gen)
transform: scale(0) on any element — always start from scale(0.95)+opacity
ease-in on any user-facing transition — use ease-out or custom cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1)
centered QR codes competing with headlines
proof cards stretched beyond content height

variance_guidance.low: Clean, centered, predictable grid. Standard symmetrical spacing. Balanced visual weight between headline and proof. Conservative border-radius (20px proof).
variance_guidance.mid: Slight asymmetry: offset margins, varied type sizes between headline and subhead. Editorial spacing rhythm with deliberate contrast between tight display tracking (-0.035em) and airy body text (line-height 1.55). Proof card offset from center.
variance_guidance.high: Strong asymmetry: massive whitespace zones, overlapping depth layers, tighter display tracking (-0.04em) with generous body spacing. Background uses subtle radial color accents at 10-16% opacity. Proof module may offset from the main grid.

html_design_engineering.philosophy: Every invisible detail compounds into something that feels right. The aggregate of correctness creates interfaces people trust without knowing why. Beauty is leverage — good defaults and good aesthetics are real differentiators.
html_design_engineering.review_format: When reviewing card output, evaluate against the design system using Before/After/Why columns. Flag any deviation from the shadow_system, border_radius_hierarchy, type_scale, or color values.
composition_rules: Headline must be the dominant visual element. Proof card is subordinate. QR is utility — never competing with either.
Two-column layouts: headline column gets 1fr-1.1fr, proof column gets 0.72fr-0.88fr. Never equal columns.
Proof card sizes to content (no min-height, no forced stretching). Empty space below a proof card is the cream background doing its job, not wasted space.
Logo aligns center to the headline text block, not to the full card height.
Footer elements (domain, source-link) are anchored to the bottom edge, not floating.
detail_quality_checks: Concentric border-radius: every nested container has a radius 2-4px smaller than its parent
All shadows use rgba(42,35,26,n) — never rgba(0,0,0,n)
Text opacity hierarchy: primary 100%, secondary 68-76%, tertiary 44-62%, disabled 30%
Label font-size 12px matches proof-label exactly — never 10px or 14px
Proof-row always has border-top separator even when it is the only footer content
